definitions.explanation: A medical professional who diagnoses and treats patients.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{医者|いしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{診|み}てもらった→診る：09798_miru⟧。
examples.english: I had a fever, so I had a doctor examine me.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{休|やす}んで→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}くて→痛い：01108_itai⟧{医者|いしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ったら→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I went to the doctor because my stomach hurt, and I received medicine.

notes:
{医者|いしゃ} is the everyday word for 'doctor' in Japanese.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {医者|いしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the doctor
- {医者|いしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{診|み}てもらう→診る：09798_miru⟧: to be examined by a doctor
- {医者|いしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掛|か}かる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to see a doctor (for treatment)
- {医者|いしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a doctor

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- ⟦お{医者|いしゃ}さん→医者：02847_isha⟧: doctor (polite, child-friendly — the most common spoken form)
- {医者|いしゃ}: doctor (neutral)
- ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧: physician (formal/official — used in documents, news, and legal contexts)

SPECIALISTS:
- ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧: dentist
- ⟦{獣医|じゅうい}→獣医：07031_juui⟧: veterinarian
- ⟦{名医|めいい}→めいい：noentry⟧: renowned doctor

PROVERB:
{医者|いしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不養生|ふようじょう}→ふようじょう：noentry⟧: the doctor neglects their own health (equivalent to 'the cobbler's children have no shoes')
